theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [Preorder β] {f : Finset α → β} [DecidableEq α] : StrictMono f ↔ ∀ (s : Finset α) ⦃a : α⦄, a ∉ s → f s < f (insert a s) := by
  intro h
  split
  · intro s a ha
    have : ∀ x ∈ s, x < a → f x < f (insert a s) :=
      by rintro x ⟨hx, hx⟩; exact h _ _ hx ha
    rw [insert_eq] at this
    apply this
  · intro h'
    refine StrictMono.domRestrict _ h'
    intro x y hxy
    rcases lt_iff_le_and_lt.1 hxy with (hle : x ≤ y) (hlt : x < y)
    cases le_total x y with hxy' hxy''
    · exact hle
    · rcases h' with ⟨s, hss, hs⟩
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hss
      have : ∀ x ∈ s, x < a → f x < f (insert a s) :=
        by rintro x ⟨hx, hx⟩; exact h' _ _ hx ha
      rw [insert_eq] at this
      apply this
